title: Expose Facial montage/export content readouts and numeric parse notes
origin: MT-044 D12/D13 split: Facial montage/export content details require chained artifact reads, and numeric fields silently coerce invalid input to defaults.

state_recovery.recovery_rule: Resume MT-054 by reading this contract, limiting edits to allowed_paths, using external CARGO_TARGET_DIR under ../Handshake_Artifacts, and keeping validator_verdict PENDING until an official validator changes it.

scope.summary: Add dedicated Facial montage/export content readouts and visible numeric parse/coercion notes so models can inspect tile maps, manifests, and invalid-input recovery without guessing.
base_scope: Add dedicated Facial montage/export content readouts and visible numeric parse/coercion notes so models can inspect tile maps, manifests, and invalid-input recovery without guessing.
acceptance_criteria: Facial montage readouts expose tile-map addresses and key manifest entries without requiring a separate artifact-read chain.
Facial export readouts expose non-destructive manifest entries without requiring a separate artifact-read chain.
Invalid numeric fields emit visible parse/coercion notes in status/receipt surfaces instead of silently falling back to defaults.
Argus can inspect the new readouts and parse notes.
risks_and_controls: Risk: readouts duplicate stale artifact content instead of reflecting the current command receipt.
Risk: parse-note wording becomes noisy and hides command status.
verification: Manual coverage proof if agent-tool rows change.

review_lenses: scope containment versus MT-044 tracker drift

handoff.summary: Exposed Facial montage/export content readouts and numeric parse notes so Argus can inspect command-result content and invalid numeric coercions without separate artifact reads.
implementation_summary: Added Facial montage/export/parse-note author IDs, state, and rendered readouts in the Facial review mode.
Added row.result-based montage/export preview helpers that expose tile map refs, manifest refs, result artifact refs, counts, dimensions, and item mappings without artifact-read chaining.
Updated Facial command drain to refresh montage/export readouts for matching active command envelopes, including non-object blocked/error results with result_available=false.
Replaced silent Facial numeric parsing on session, claim, montage, and export command paths with note-producing parse helpers.

Surfaced numeric parse notes in the dedicated parse-note readout, command receipt, and ingest status, including transport-error status paths; local pre-dispatch blockers reset stale notes to numeric_parse_notes none.
Updated internal manual prose and agent-tool rows for the three new Argus inspect surfaces.
